subject: general
question: A truck covers a distance of 140 km at a speed of 35 km/h. It covers the next 20 km in 30 minutes and the last 30 km at a speed of 60 km/h. What is the average speed (in km/h) of the truck?
solution:
Formula used:&
lt;/span>

Average speed = Total distance covered ÷ Total time 

Calculation:

Total distance = 140 km + 20 km + 30 km = 190 km 

Total time = 140over35 + 30over60 + 30over60 = 5 hrs

Average speed = 190over5 = 38 km/h

∴ The average speed is 38 km/h.
